items.name: KIVIK Sofa - Gunnared beige
items.why: KIVIK in beige is a neutral, calm anchor that suits the white walls and light laminate floor. At 2.28 m wide it suits the 8.9 m long room.

items.name: POÄNG Armchair - birch veneer/Knisa light beige
items.why: PÖÄNG has a birch veneer frame in light beige fabric, which adds the warm light wood the brief asks for and matches the light laminate. At $149 it leaves room in the budget.

items.name: LACK Coffee table - black-brown 46 1/2x30 3/4 "
items.why: UGGLERUM walnut-veneer coffee table adds a warmer wood tone that grounds the sofa. Its 1.3 m length suits the sofa and the large floor area.
